pending: MPI and third-party transitive dependency replacement

separation.generated: external declarations, export list, argument/status conversion selected at build time
separation.internal: Zynum-owned numerical types and algorithms; one existing Core with shared context, allocator, admission, resource pins, thread and workspace policy
separation.profile_selection: FFTW first; DFTI retained as an optional candidate; profiles must not instantiate separate internal owners

semantic_acceptance: Unnormalized transforms, sign -1/+1, row-major last axis contiguous, real half-spectrum packing and DCT-I endpoint weights.
Plan binds caller-owned arrays; repeated execute uses those arrays. Planning failure returns NULL; execute and destroy retain FFTW void signatures.
FFTW_ESTIMATE planning preserves input and output. WISDOM_ONLY requires matching wisdom; do not silently treat it as ESTIMATE.
Accept legal in-place layouts using FFTW physical padding; unsupported initial cases must remain explicitly pending, rather than pretending full compatibility.
Honor preserve/destroy input restrictions, including NULL for multidimensional c2r plus PRESERVE_INPUT as documented.
Immutable plan metadata and invocation-owned work must permit concurrent execution on distinct arrays; a shared mutable per-plan workspace is insufficient.
FFTW has no finite-input validation status channel. Preserve IEEE exceptional-value behavior instead of silently retaining output on a checked numerical failure.
Use captured shared allocator and resource pins for plan/buffer lifetime; release allocation before pin, including teardown after close; no second context/cache/handle registry.
Buffer allocation alignment, overflow/OOM handling, external C/C++ calls and physical ABPLaS regressions are separate mandatory acceptance gates.
